The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem of finding an f -coloring of a graph can be reduced to the problem of finding a proper edge-coloring of the graph.
the problem of finding ordinary edge-colorings is easier than the problem of finding f -colorings.
for a wide variety of graphs the ordinary edge-coloring problem is equivalent to a special case of the f -coloring problem, namely, f -coloring with a constant upper bound on f.
